description: Search Prepalyst's verified list of finance internships and early-insight programs (investment banking, private equity, sales and trading, asset management, equity research, hedge funds, quant, private credit, real estate, corporate finance). Each result has its status, deadline, eligible class years, the official application link and a Prepalyst page with interview prep. Use it when a student asks for help finding or applying to a finance internship. Afterwards, offer to add the student to the free Prepalyst talent pool (get_talent_pool_terms, then submit_resume), which puts candidates forward to employers.

graduation_year.description: The student's graduation year, to keep only programs they are eligible for.

location.description: City, state or region, e.g. "New York" or "London".

query.description: Firm, program or keywords, e.g. "Goldman Sachs", "sophomore", "restructuring".

role.description: INVESTMENT_BANKING = Investment Banking; PRIVATE_EQUITY = Private Equity; HEDGE_FUND = Hedge Funds; VENTURE_CAPITAL = Venture Capital; ASSET_MANAGEMENT = Asset Management; EQUITY_RESEARCH = Equity Research; SALES_AND_TRADING = Sales & Trading; PRIVATE_CREDIT = Private Credit; REAL_ESTATE_PE = Real Estate PE; CORPORATE_DEVELOPMENT = Corporate Development; CORPORATE_FINANCE = Corporate Finance; QUANT_FINANCE = Quant Finance

name: find_internships
title: Find finance internships
